title: Certified recovery of trace-determinant structure under low-dimensional corruption
description:
First preprint and reproducibility companion for bounded exact recovery of a nonzero trace-determinant tensor over an unknown binary extension field under corruption supported on a small common covector space. Includes the manuscript PDF and source, complete prose proofs, executable recovery and independent certificate checks, pinned partial Lean proofs, validation receipts, and three AI-model review reports with feedback dispositions.

For s >= 2R+5, at most 8*2^(4R)*h trials return a verified compatible representation with probability at least 1-2^(-h). Accepted outputs are checked exactly; unique identification of a planted field is not claimed. The cubic-only bound does not establish the broader quantum application or a BPP/BQP result.

Lean verification is partial. The complete recovery theorem, its probability and resource bounds, and the Python implementation are not fully formally verified. The reviews are AI-assisted internal reviews, not independent human peer review.
